profile_text.body:
Datadog, Inc. is a public company headquartered in New York, NY, traded under the ticker DDOG, and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001561550. On its own website, the company describes its core offering as cloud monitoring as a service, presenting a way to see metrics from all of your apps, tools and services in one place. It also markets a security angle, describing how integrating security and observability can help organizations decode runtime execution, eliminate exposure in dynamic AI environments, and carry out detection and response with what it calls agentic speed against AI-powered attacks.

The site material does not name specific Datadog products, and no products are otherwise recorded for the company. No lawsuits involving the company are recorded, and no MCP servers are listed. The company's recorded law exposure is in New York, with a count of 459.
